title: UAE Golden Visa: Eligibility and how to apply
summary: See who qualifies for the UAE Golden Visa and how to apply. Routes, thresholds and steps, checked against official sources. Start planning your move.
body_markdown:
The UAE Golden Visa offers long-term residency to investors, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals and individuals with exceptional talent who want to live and build their future in the United Arab Emirates. Depending on the eligibility category, the visa is typically valid for five or ten years and can be renewed.


Unlike standard residency permits, the UAE Golden Visa allows eligible holders to live, work and study in the country without requiring a national sponsor. It also offers greater flexibility for individuals seeking long-term stability, career opportunities and business growth in the UAE.


Eligibility depends on factors such as professional qualifications, salary, investment value, business ownership or recognised achievements. Applicants must meet the specific requirements for their chosen category and provide supporting documents.


The application process generally involves identifying the appropriate eligibility route, gathering the required documents and submitting an application through the relevant UAE government authority or approved channel.


Understanding the eligibility criteria, documentation requirements and application process can help prospective applicants make informed decisions before applying for the UAE Golden Visa.


## **What is the UAE Golden Visa?**


The UAE Golden Visa is a long-term residence permit introduced by the United Arab Emirates to attract investors, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals, scientists and individuals with exceptional talents. It allows eligible foreign nationals to live in the country and pursue career, business or educational opportunities without needing a traditional national sponsor.


The visa is generally issued for five or ten years, depending on the applicant’s eligibility category and the applicable requirements. It is renewable, provided the holder continues to meet the relevant conditions. The validity period offers greater stability for individuals and families planning to establish long-term roots in the UAE.


One of the key benefits of the UAE Golden Visa is self-sponsored residency. Unlike many standard employment-based residence permits, holders do not need an employer or UAE national to sponsor their residency. This provides greater independence when changing jobs, managing businesses or exploring professional opportunities.


For eligible applicants, the UAE Golden Visa offers more than extended residency. It provides flexibility to build a career, invest, study and plan for the future in one of the Middle East’s leading business and lifestyle destinations, subject to applicable laws and visa conditions.


## **Who Is Eligible for the UAE Golden Visa?**


Your eligibility for the[UAE Golden Visa](https://u.ae/en/information-and-services/visa-and-emirates-id/Types-of-visas/golden-visa) depends on your professional achievements, investments, qualifications or exceptional abilities, with specific requirements for each applicant category.


### **Investors**


Investors may qualify through eligible public investments or real estate investments that meet the UAE’s financial and regulatory requirements. Applicants must provide supporting documents to demonstrate that their investments satisfy the applicable criteria.


### **Entrepreneurs**


Entrepreneurs may qualify through business ownership, approved projects or demonstrated entrepreneurial achievements, depending on the relevant eligibility category. Applicants must meet the applicable conditions and provide evidence of their business activities or project qualifications.


### **Skilled professionals**


Skilled professionals may be eligible based on their occupation, educational qualifications, employment status, salary and other requirements. Eligibility depends on the applicant’s professional category and the relevant government regulations.


### **Students and graduates**


Outstanding students and graduates may qualify based on academic performance, examination results and recognised institutional criteria. Specific requirements apply depending on their educational background and the relevant eligibility pathway.


### **Exceptional talent**


Individuals with exceptional abilities in fields such as science, technology, arts, culture and sports may qualify through relevant approvals. Applicants may need to demonstrate recognised achievements, specialised expertise or professional distinction, depending on their field.


## **Investment routes and thresholds**


The UAE Golden Visa offers long-term residency to eligible investors through property ownership and qualifying capital investments. The minimum investment threshold for these routes is generally AED 2 million, subject to the applicable eligibility criteria and documentation requirements.


### **Property investment**


The property investment route requires real estate with a combined value of at least AED 2 million. Multiple properties may be combined to meet the threshold. Certain off-plan and mortgaged properties may qualify, depending on the emirate and applicable conditions.


### **Capital and public investments**


Investors may qualify by investing at least AED 2 million in an eligible UAE investment fund or qualifying business. An approved bank deposit may also meet the requirements, subject to the relevant regulations and supporting documentation.


### **The 23 Lakh Rumour**


Online claims about a UAE Golden Visa costing approximately ₹23 lakh, or AED 100,000, have caused confusion. This amount should not be mistaken for the standard investment threshold for the Golden Visa. Any offer promising residency at a significantly lower cost should be verified through official UAE government channels before payment.

## **How to apply for the UAE Golden Visa**


### **Step-by-Step application process**


**1. Check your eligibility and apply**


Choose the appropriate Golden Visa category and submit your application or nomination request through the relevant authority. Upload supporting documents, such as your property title deed, investment evidence or salary certificate, as required.


**2. Obtain an entry permit if required**


If you are applying from outside the UAE, check whether you need an entry permit to complete the residency process. Eligible applicants may use a six-month multiple-entry permit, subject to approval and applicable rules.


**3. Complete your medical fitness test**


Once in the UAE, complete the required medical fitness examination at an authorised centre. This typically includes a blood test and chest X-ray.


**4. Submit your final application**


Provide the remaining documents, including your medical fitness results and proof of health insurance, where required. Pay the applicable fees and wait for the authorities to process your application.


**5. Complete biometrics and receive your Emirates ID**


Attend your biometrics appointment if required. Once your application is approved, your Emirates ID and Golden Residency will be processed.


### **Where to apply**


You can submit your UAE Golden Visa application online through the relevant government portal or get assistance in person at an authorised service centre.


- **ICP:** The[Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security](https://smartservices.icp.gov.ae/) handles applications across Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah.
- **GDRFA Dubai:** If your application is connected to Dubai, use the[General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs](https://www.gdrfad.gov.ae/) .
- **Amer and authorised typing centres:** Visit an approved centre in the UAE for help preparing and submitting your application.


### **Required documents**


Prepare the following documents before applying. Additional requirements depend on your eligibility category.


- **Valid passport:** A clear copy of your passport. Six months' validity is commonly recommended.
- **Current visa or status documents:** Provide your existing UAE residence visa, visit visa or cancellation documents, as applicable.
- **Medical fitness certificate:** Submit the certificate issued by an authorised UAE medical centre when required.
- **Health insurance:** Provide valid UAE health insurance or any alternative documentation permitted for your category.
- **Passport photograph:** Prepare a recent digital photograph that meets the UAE authorities' specifications, typically with a white background.

## **Frequently asked questions about the UAE Golden Visa**


### **Who qualifies for the UAE Golden Visa?**


Eligible applicants include real estate investors, entrepreneurs, skilled professionals, exceptional talents and outstanding students. Each category has specific financial, academic or professional requirements. Applicants must meet the relevant criteria and provide supporting documents to qualify for long-term UAE residency.


### **How long is the UAE Golden Visa valid?**


The UAE Golden Visa is generally valid for five or ten years, depending on your eligibility category. It can be renewed if you continue to meet the applicable requirements. This long-term residency offers greater stability for professionals, investors and families planning to live in the UAE.


### **How much do you need to invest?**


The minimum investment threshold for qualifying property and capital investment routes is generally AED 2 million. Skilled professionals may qualify through a separate route, subject to salary, qualification and employment requirements, including a monthly salary threshold of AED 30,000 for eligible categories.


### **Can your family join you?**


Yes. Golden Visa holders can sponsor eligible family members, including their spouse and children, subject to applicable requirements. They may also sponsor domestic workers under the relevant rules. This allows families to enjoy greater stability while living together in the UAE.


### **How do you apply for the UAE Golden Visa?**


Applications can be submitted through the relevant government authority, including ICP or GDRFA Dubai, depending on your emirate and category. Prepare your supporting documents, submit the application, complete required medical checks and biometrics, and pay applicable fees.


### **How can you move money to the UAE?**


You can transfer funds to the UAE through international bank transfers or authorised money transfer providers. A local UAE bank account can help manage incoming funds and everyday expenses. Keep supporting documents for larger transfers and comply with applicable banking and anti-money laundering requirements.
